name: Will This Bitter Night Bring Change? - Two Women in Trouble
source:
Follow Hornet and Emily in their attempt to escape the City, in all its neon glory.

Based on the story 'Brüderchen und Schwesterchen,' Brothers Grimm, 1812.

[From [url=https://mia-cain.itch.io/wtbnbc]itch.io[/url] and in-game description]
translation:
跟随大黄蜂和艾米丽一起尝试逃离这座霓虹灯璀璨的城市。

改编自格林兄弟1812年的故事“Brüderchen und Schwesterchen”。

[来自[url=https://mia-cain.itch.io/wtbnbc]itch.io[/url] 和游戏内描述]
